problem: '民意調查' is the public-opinion/political sense; a customer poll here is an opinion survey of customers, so the gloss maps to the wrong sense.
'have' is itself the base form, so 'must 後接原形' is a false reason; 'must have labeled' is grammatical (past deduction) and fails on voice and meaning.
fix: must have + p.p. 是推測過去；且容器是被標示，要被動

problem: The gloss reverses unless: 'worn unless you handle' means worn when you are NOT handling them; 「除非處理才要戴」 actually describes the correct meaning and reinforces the classic 除非 misreading.
fix: 語意相反：unless = if not，變成「不處理時才要戴」
